opportunities.title: Nuffield Farming Scholarship

amount.raw: A bursary of £9,000 will be given towards the Scholars study tour and subsistence expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must work within the farming, food, horticultural, forestry, rural and associated industries; be aged between 25 and 45 years (upper age limit 45 on 31st July in the year of application); be three years post tertiary education; be resident in the UK and hold a UK passport or work directly for UK agriculture. No academic qualifications required. Not awarded to anyone in full-time education or to further research projects.
opportunities.summary: Awards approximately 25 individuals each year a bursary to conduct a study tour of no less than 8 weeks anywhere in the world to research topics in farming, food, horticulture, forestry or other countryside and ancillary industries, plus professional and leadership development (conferences, seminars, training).

opportunities.title: Nuffield Farming Next-Gen Scholarship

amount.raw: A Next-Gen Scholarship worth £6,000, fully funded including all travel and subsistence, plus a £1,000 financial incentive to part cover replacement labour cost

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Aimed at young people aged 18-24 in the UK with a demonstrable interest in the relevant industry (e.g. dairy, regenerative agriculture, pig).
opportunities.summary: A 30-day study tour for young people aged 18-24 to develop talent within the industry, staying on farms with Nuffield Scholars, including an induction day in London, attendance at the Nuffield Conference and Nuffield Farming Associate membership. For 2027, plans to award three dairy and three pig scholarships.
